control: Original through-2021 predictors with their original 2023 H1 interval factors
cohort: Common usable stock-date/horizon inputs across both vintages within each seed. Same cohort for raw distributions, calibrated pipelines and calibration-only comparison.
primary: Date-equal maximum-high/minimum-low MAE and nominal 80% interval coverage and score at two and five days; report targets individually and equally averaged.
secondary: Range forecast, raw-distribution CRPS, interval width, lower/upper miss rates, usable input and path fractions.
decision: Assess direction, magnitude, target and seed consistency and local regressions together. Do not reject a useful change solely because one confidence interval crosses zero. Record transfer limitations separately from earlier demonstrated improvements.
frozen: Predictor and decoder weights, sampling, both calibration fits and factor-to-checkpoint bindings are fixed before generation. No neural-network training, calibration fitting or evaluation-based retuning.
interpretation: Later development-window transfer for this frozen combined profile; this period was examined by earlier model experiments, so it is not an untouched final test. Official tokenizer pretraining coverage remains unresolved. No formal future coverage guarantee.
